title: Base-red ExUnit identity

reply.text:
Difficulty: easy

## Acceptance criteria
- A1: Hello.greet/0 returns Hello, Almir!

## Technical approach
Change the return value.

## Implementation steps
1. Edit lib/hello.ex.

arguments.cmd:
printf 'defmodule Hello do
  def greet, do: "Hello, Almir!"
end
' > lib/hello.ex

fixture_files.test/hello_test.exs:
defmodule HelloTest do
  use ExUnit.Case

  test "legacy is broken" do
    assert Hello.greet() == "Hi!"
  end
end
fixture_files..kogen/project.yaml:
name: hello
checks:
  - name: compile
    argv: [mix, compile, --warnings-as-errors]
    timeout_ms: 300000
  - name: unit
    argv: [mix, test, test/hello_test.exs]
    timeout_ms: 300000
setup:
  - name: compile
    argv: [mix, compile]
    timeout_ms: 300000
setup_outputs: [_build]
domains:
  app: [lib]

notes: The unit check fails on the base with the ExUnit test `legacy is broken`; after the change the same identity fails, so the check is excused and the Build lands.
